goal: Generate a directly usable static website as files only. Separate content, CSS template/theme, JS logic, and assets. Do not create any build tool, generator script, backend, or web server.
core_idea: index.html is the single page shell.
content lives in JSON files under /content.
the visual theme lives in CSS files under /templates.
client-side logic lives in JS files under /js.
routing is hash-based for zero-config local use.
the result is already the website itself, not a project that builds a website.
index_html_rules: must be directly usable as the website entry file
must contain a root mount element for page rendering
must not depend on any backend or build step

template_rules.purpose: define the visual appearance of the website

must: load page content from /content/*.json or embedded page manifest
render the selected page into index.html
support navigation without full page reload

implementation_prompt.title: Generate a direct file-based static website
requirements: deliver only the website files themselves
do not create any web server
generate a directly usable static website structure
index.html must be the entry file
templates/default.css must define the default visual theme
content/*.json files must contain the page content
use hash routing for local zero-config use
